// @control-plane
// GREEN fixture for `control-plane-pii-free` — the TENANCY ownership slice (P-CP-04 / P-028).
// The lint MUST admit this. This is the FROZEN four-field `CrossCellPointer` bridge frame exactly
// as P-CP-02 / P-027 freezes it (refined-arch tenancy §6.1): it carries ONLY four opaque,
// PII-free fields — `subject` is an OpaqueSubjectId (an ArtifactRef-class id, NEVER a person),
// `type` is a coarse artifact-kind enum, `correlation_id` is a trace label, `home_cell` is a
// routing key. NO field is classified `is_personal=true` (no `#[personal_data]` tag) and NO field
// is PII-named. The control plane carries opaque ids only (ADR-11.4; §3.3 ZERO in-region PII).
pub struct CrossCellPointer {
    subject: OpaqueSubjectId,
    #[serde(rename = "type")]
    r#type: ArtifactType,
    correlation_id: CorrelationId,
    home_cell: CellId,
}
